comment: Monitoring Reader at subscription scope and nothing else — a plausible 'least privilege' counter-offer from a customer. Metrics would flow; inventory would not, and there is nothing to collect metrics FOR. No pattern here matches Microsoft.Resources/subscriptions/resources/read, so scope_verified is false and the code is SCOPE_UNVERIFIED (Req 12.3). Recorded because a 200 carrying a long, legitimate-looking action list is the case an implementation that merely checks 'are there any entries' gets wrong.
